atAGlance: Gà ta nướng is free-range chicken grilled over heat, usually with firm meat, crisp skin, lime leaves, and dipping salt.
whatItIs: Gà ta nướng is grilled free-range chicken, usually chewier and more flavorful than industrial chicken, often served with lime leaves, herbs, and dipping salt.
howToEnjoy: Eat the grilled pieces with herbs and a light touch of lime-pepper salt. Expect chew; that firmer texture is part of why people order gà ta.
howLocalsOrder: Order gà ta nướng when you want free-range chicken with real chew. Ask for dipping salt on the side, less chili, or extra herbs before serving.
worthKnowing: Gà ta means local/free-range chicken, prized in Vietnam for texture and deeper chicken flavor.
goodToKnow: Gà ta can be firmer and more flavorful than standard chicken; ask if it is chopped bone-in before ordering.
